Messages.Author: Marc Gabriele
Messages.Body:
Does the tapping effect of superior Propaganda occur at the declaration of
the action, or at the conclusion? If at the conclusion, does the bleed
need to have been successful? (not blocked, Telepathically Countered,
etc.)

Marc G.

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <Pine.SUN.3.96L.100111...@alycia.dementia.org>,
Marc Gabriele <goo...@dementia.org> wrote:

>Does the tapping effect of superior Propaganda occur at the declaration of
>the action, or at the conclusion?

At the conclusion.

>If at the conclusion, does the bleed
>need to have been successful? (not blocked, Telepathically Countered,
>etc.)

The card doesn't make that requirement, so unlike Kindred Spirits, Legal
Manipulation, and Social Charm, all of which have an "if bleed is successful"
condition attached to the pool gain, Propaganda relies only on the
action being unblocked. An unblocked bleed for 0 with Propaganda will
still tap somebody.

gomi
